plan.method: Repeated-stage process median of nine raw samples, then median of three fresh-process values; single stages use three fresh-process median. All original values and process receipts retained.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json

d = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
archive = d / 'gate-attempt1'
archive.mkdir()
names = ['source-identity.json', 'source.tar']
for platform in ('windows', 'linux'):
    names += [f'phase-gate-{platform}.json', f'phase-gate-{platform}-wrapper.log',
              f'gate-{platform}.log', f'gate-{platform}.exit']
records = {}
for name in names:
    source = (d / name).resolve()
    target = (archive / name).resolve()
    assert source.parent == d and target.parent == archive
    assert source.is_file() and not target.exists()
    records[name] = {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),

          'performanceProbesExecuted': 0}

print('Archived both failed gates and their 6331-source snapshot; zero performance runs')

"""Seal the clean 557c48b source and Rust link dependencies before editing.

Only Git/tool identity reads, source hashing/tarring and artifact copying occur.
No build, link, test, performance probe or host integration is started.
"""
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile

ROOT = Path.cwd().resolve()
D = ROOT / ".local/alert-budget-20261005"
PRIOR = ROOT / ".local/append-capacity-20261004"
EXPECTED_HEAD = "557c48b0670af5143b4ffd12af65a69fc3ba809e"
EXPECTED_ADDED = {
    "docs/APPEND_HISTORY_VALUEWHEN_REPAIR_20261005.md",
    "docs/APPEND_HISTORY_VALUEWHEN_REPAIR_RESULTS_20261005.json",
}


def sha(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))


def save(path, value):
    # Explicit bytes avoid Windows text-mode CRLF translation.
    Path(path).write_bytes((json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
                           + "\n").encode("utf8"))


def output(command):
    return subprocess.check_output(command, cwd=ROOT).decode("utf8").strip()


def source_paths():
    return sorted(set(subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "ls-files", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z"],
        cwd=ROOT,
    ).decode("utf8").split("\0")) - {""})


assert not output(["git", "status", "--porcelain"]), "Dirty baseline"
base = output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"])
assert base == EXPECTED_HEAD, (base, EXPECTED_HEAD)
assert not (D / "before-source-identity.json").exists(), "Baseline already sealed"
assert not (D / "before-binary-identity.json").exists(), "Baseline already sealed"
assert not (D / "before-source.tar").exists(), "Partial prior freeze requires investigation"
assert not (D / "baseline").exists(), "Partial artifact archive requires investigation"
D.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

compiled_path = PRIOR / "source-identity.json"
prior_link_path = PRIOR / "identity-capacity-after.json"
compiled = read(compiled_path)
prior_link = read(prior_link_path)
assert len(compiled["files"]) == 6324
assert prior_link["sourceManifestSha256"] == sha(compiled_path)
assert prior_link["probe"] == "capacity" and prior_link["tag"] == "after"
assert prior_link["sourceSha256"] == sha(PRIOR / "capacity_probe.rs")
assert prior_link["executableSha256"] == sha(PRIOR / "capacity-after.exe")

run_phase.py.content:
"""Bind a concrete validation/build/link invocation to frozen source before and after."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,subprocess,time
from evidence_common import D,ROOT,sha,read,save

def verify():
    manifest=read(D/'source-identity.json')
    changed=[p for p,h in manifest['files'].items() if not (ROOT/p).is_file() or sha(ROOT/p)!=h]
    if changed: raise ValueError('Source changed: '+repr(changed))
    return {'manifestSha256':sha(D/'source-identity.json'),'archiveSha256':sha(D/'source.tar'),
            'files':len(manifest['files']),'sourceVerified':True}

def main():
    name=sys.argv[1];command=sys.argv[2:]; assert command
    before=verify(); entry={'phase':name,'command':command,'before':before,'startedUnixSeconds':time.time(),
                            'wrapperSha256':sha(Path(__file__)),'status':'running'}
    path=D/f'phase-{name}.json';assert not path.exists(),path
    save(path,entry)
    with (D/f'phase-{name}-wrapper.log').open('wb') as log:
        completed=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    entry.update(returncode=completed.returncode,finishedUnixSeconds=time.time(),
                 wrapperLogSha256=sha(D/f'phase-{name}-wrapper.log'))
    after=verify(); assert before==after
    entry.update(after=after,status='passed' if completed.returncode==0 else 'failed')
    if name.startswith('gate-'):
        (D/(name+'.exit')).write_text(str(completed.returncode),encoding='utf8')
        gate_log=D/(name+'.log')
        entry.update(gateLogSha256=sha(gate_log) if gate_log.exists() else None,
                     gateExitSha256=sha(D/(name+'.exit')))
    elif name=='release':
        entry.update(buildLogSha256=sha(D/'build-release.log'),buildExitSha256=sha(D/'build-release.exit'))
    elif name.startswith('link-'):
        _,probe,tag=name.split('-');entry.update(linkReceiptSha256=sha(D/f'identity-{probe}-{tag}.json'),
            linkLogSha256=sha(D/f'link-{probe}-{tag}.log'))
    save(path,entry); print(name,entry['status'],'frozen files',before['files'],flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)

if __name__=='__main__':main()

import json

import tarfile

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
out = root / '.local/alert-budget-20261005'

import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import sys

directory = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
identity = json.loads((directory / 'source-identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])

    file = root / path

        different.append(path)

    raise SystemExit(f'Frozen source mismatch: {different}')
